name: dogfood-nextjs-webrtc-video-app
description: Dogfood app v1.28-2 — a Next.js 15 + mediasoup SFU + coturn TURN + WebRTC video/audio call room that exercises signaling / ice / track / simulcast / reconnect across a provider-neutral WebRTC adapter, drivable in both KIWA_MODE=real (calls mediasoup + coturn testcontainers when WEBRTC_MEDIASOUP_READY=1) and KIWA_MODE=mock (@kiwa-lab/realtime v0.2 createWebRtcSignalingMock + createWebRtcIceMock + createWebRtcTrackMock) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics 12-axis release gate.
